title: My check-in

hint.checklist: One item per line; start it with [x] once done.
hint.text: Free text, on as many lines as needed.

notFound: Ronde could not find this check-in for you. The email of your Slack account must be the one of your Ronde profile, and you must take part in the meeting.
tooLong: This check-in is too long to edit in Slack. Please open it in Ronde.
itemTooLong: One item is longer than {max} characters.
changed: Your check-in changed in Ronde in the meantime. Close this form and open it again to get the latest version.
saved: Your check-in for “{team}” is saved. Thanks!
noMeetings: You take part in no meeting of this workspace.
unknown: Ronde does not know you yet: the email of your Slack account must be the one of your profile in a Ronde workspace that added the app.
unavailable: Ronde could not answer right now. Please try again in a moment.

settings.intro: Add Ronde to your Slack workspace: everyone fills in their check-in without leaving Slack.
settings.locked: The Slack app comes with Ronde {edition}.

uses.reminders: Check-in reminders by direct message, with a button that opens the check-in as a Slack form.
uses.channel: The channel you pick becomes a connector: in each meeting’s notifications, choose what is posted there (minutes, session about to start…).
uses.command: /ronde shows each person their next sessions and open follow-up actions.

settings.emailMatch: People are recognized by their email: their Slack account and their Ronde profile must share it.
settings.remindersHint: By direct message, in place of the email, to the people found in Slack. The others still get the email.
settings.disconnectConfirm: Remove Ronde from this Slack workspace? Reminders go back to email, and the notification rules posting to its channel are deleted.
settings.notConfigured: To use Slack, the administrator of this Ronde instance first creates its Slack app. It takes a few minutes.

result.cancelled: The installation was cancelled in Slack.
result.denied: Only the people who manage the workspace’s connectors can add Slack.
result.failed: Slack could not be connected. Please try again; if it keeps failing, contact the administrator of this instance.
